First test output, then the microphone, then conversation. The selected mode applies to Start in Android Auto and to the phone test. Microphone test reads back one sentence without sending it to an AI provider or saving it. Car recognition is on-device; a phone speech service may process audio online. Conversation sends recognized text to the selected provider, uses your API credits and saves the chat encrypted in this test app. Test while parked.
1. Output test — no microphone or AI
2. Microphone and recognition test — no AI
3. Conversation — selected AI provider

Phone test uses the phone microphone. To test the car microphone, choose the mode here, open OpenAuto AI in Android Auto and press Start there. End stops recognition, playback and pending requests. Leaving the active surface ends its session. No automatic restart.
